records.title: FORM-10-Q
records.text: Revenues increased $85.0 million in the recent quarter compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2021 due to increased revenues from both our Industrial & Commercial products and Home & Life products.

records.title: FORM-10-Q
records.text: Increased product demand and production capacity constraints have increased the selling price and costs of our products, and has resulted in period-to-period fluctuations in our gross margin.

records.title: FORM-10-Q
records.text: Testing performed by such third parties facilitates faster delivery of products to our customers (particularly those located in Asia), shorter production cycle times, lower inventory requirements, lower costs and increased flexibility of test capacity.

records.title: FORM-10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased to 61.4% in the recent quarter compared to 59.2% in the third quarter of fiscal 2021 due to variations in product mix and increases in the price of our products.

records.title: FORM-10-Q
records.text: Operating income (loss) in the recent quarter was $30.2 million compared to $(9.3) million in the third quarter of fiscal 2021.
